description: Settings and metadata for the connected Xero organisation — legal name, base currency, country, financial year end, sales tax basis and period, timezone, subscription class/edition, and the period/end-of-year lock dates. Read-only and single-row: GET Organisation returns exactly one record, for the tenant named by the transport's Xero-tenant-id header. No pagination is authored — Xero documents none on this resource and the response carries no pagination envelope. No replication block: the Organisation model exposes CreatedDateUTC only and has no UpdatedDateUTC or any other watermark (confirmed against all three generated Xero SDKs, and against the 2026-07-13 spec commit that added UpdatedDateUTCString to CreditNote/Invoice/Overpayment/Payment/Prepayment but deliberately not to Organisation), so incremental sync is not expressible and full_refresh is the only method; no If-Modified-Since param is declared. No write operations: Xero exposes neither PUT Organisation nor POST Organisation. Two deliberate shape notes. (1) The singular/plural asymmetry is real and is Xero's own — the request path is Organisation but the records come back under an Organisations array; neither side is a typo and neither was 'corrected'. (2) The provider's APIKey property is intentionally absent from response.schema: it is a live per-organisation credential (the Xero-to-Xero document-exchange key), it carries no analytical value, and the api-endpoint contract offers no field-level secret or masking affordance for a response field — authoring it would replicate a working credential into the destination warehouse in plaintext, where backups and downstream copies make the exposure irreversible. Every other Organisation property is surfaced.

schema.title: Xero GET Organisation response
schema.description: Xero wraps records in the standard response envelope alongside Id/Status/ProviderName/DateTimeUTC metadata; the Organisations array carries the records. It always holds exactly one element — the tenant selected by connection.selections.tenantId.

Id.description: Envelope: request correlation id assigned by Xero.

Status.description: Envelope: request status, 'OK' on success. Not the per-organisation OrganisationStatus field.

ProviderName.description: Envelope: the name of the calling Xero app.

DateTimeUTC.description: Envelope: response timestamp in Xero MS-JSON form, e.g. /Date(1550797359081)/.

Organisations.description: The record collection. Always a single-element array on this resource.

OrganisationID.description: Xero identifier for the organisation, and the primary key of this resource. The spec marks no Organisation property required; this one is kept non-null as the documented unique identifier.

Name.description: Display name of the organisation, e.g. Sweet Xero org.

LegalName.description: Registered legal name, e.g. V Sweet Xero Org.

PaysTax.description: Whether the organisation is registered with a local tax authority.

Version.description: Regional version of Xero the organisation runs, e.g. AU.

OrganisationType.description: Organisation type, e.g. COMPANY. Same value domain as OrganisationEntityType.

BaseCurrency.description: Default currency of the organisation as an ISO-4217 code, e.g. AUD. The spec closes this domain but at 130+ members; surfaced as an open string since the arrow type is Utf8 either way.

CountryCode.description: Country of the organisation as an ISO-3166 alpha-2 code, e.g. AU. Closed in the spec but at 250-odd members; surfaced as an open string.

IsDemoCompany.description: Whether this is a Xero demo company rather than a real organisation.

OrganisationStatus.description: Status of the organisation, e.g. ACTIVE. NOT a closed enum in the spec — generated as a bare string in all three Xero SDKs, so no value domain is declared rather than guessing one.

RegistrationNumber.description: Company registration number. Only available for NZ, AU and UK organisations.

TaxNumber.description: Local tax number — ABN, GST number, VAT number and so on, depending on Version.

FinancialYearEndDay.description: Calendar day the financial year ends on, e.g. 30.

FinancialYearEndMonth.description: Calendar month the financial year ends in, 1-12, e.g. 6.

SalesTaxBasis.description: Basis on which sales tax is reported, e.g. ACCRUALS. The domain is region-dependent; both ACCRUAL and ACCRUALS are live members.

SalesTaxPeriod.description: Frequency of sales tax reporting, e.g. QUARTERLY1. The digit-prefixed (1MONTHLY) and spelled-out (ONEMONTHS) variants are BOTH live in the spec and are deliberately not de-duplicated.

DefaultSalesTax.description: Default sales tax setting as a human display string, e.g. 'Tax Exclusive'. NOT a LineAmountTypes token — do not join it to line-amount enums.

DefaultPurchasesTax.description: Default purchases tax setting as a human display string, e.g. 'Tax Inclusive'.

PeriodLockDate.description: Date up to which the accounts are locked for non-advisers, in the Xero MS-JSON date-only envelope (e.g. /Date(1481846400000+0000)/). Calendar date, no time component. Shown only if set.

EndOfYearLockDate.description: Date up to which the accounts are locked for all users, in the Xero MS-JSON date-only envelope. Calendar date, no time component. Shown only if set.

CreatedDateUTC.description: Timestamp the organisation was created in Xero, MS-JSON form with a time component, e.g. /Date(1572552096000)/. Zone-aware per that sample (Xero states a zoneless MS-JSON value is UTC). This is the only temporal watermark on the resource, and Xero exposes no filter param for it, so it is NOT usable as a replication cursor.

Timezone.description: Xero timezone token for the organisation, e.g. AUSEASTERNSTANDARDTIME. Closed in the spec but at 100+ members; surfaced as an open string. Not an IANA zone name.

OrganisationEntityType.description: Entity type of the organisation, e.g. COMPANY. Shares the OrganisationType value domain and usually agrees with it.

ShortCode.description: Short code identifying the organisation in Xero's practice-management URLs, e.g. !v9Mrp.

Class.description: Subscription class of the organisation, e.g. PREMIUM. Domain current as of 2026-07; BASICLITE and ULTRA verified against the 2026-05 and 2026-04 spec commits. Xero adds members here over time — treat as append-only.

Edition.description: Edition of the organisation, e.g. BUSINESS.

LineOfBusiness.description: Free-text description of the organisation's line of business.

Addresses.description: Address details of the organisation (POBOX / STREET / DELIVERY entries); surfaced opaque.

Phones.description: Phone details of the organisation (DEFAULT / DDI / MOBILE / FAX entries); surfaced opaque.

ExternalLinks.description: Organisation website and social-media links; surfaced opaque.

PaymentTerms.description: Default bill and sales payment terms (Day + Type per side); surfaced opaque.
